test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 06 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Such problems include difficulty in implementing decisions, providing social security to everyone and ensuring employment.

B. This is because almost all countries face problems related to their population.

C. The most crucial aspect of the problem is population pressure.

D. The population explosion is an important issue these days.
solution:
The correct answer is "DBAC"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Let's look at the correct sequence of the passage. 
 
• Statement D is the opening sentence of the passage as it gives a brief introduction to the major concern of current population growth.
 
• Statement B is the second sentence of the passage which explains that it is due to the fact that practically all countries suffer population-related issues.
 
• Statement A is the third sentence of the passage which explains problems such as difficulty in executing decisions, providing social security to everybody, and assuring employment are examples of such issues.
 
• Statement C is the last sentence of the passage which shows that population pressure is the most critical part of the problem.

Hence, the correct sequence is D, B, A, C

The correct answer is option 3.

The correct passage is: ***D**. The population explosion is an important issue these days. **B**. This is because almost all countries face problems related to their population. **A**. Such problems include difficulty in implementing decisions, providing social security to everyone and ensuring employment. **C**. The most crucial aspect of the problem is population pressure.*
